events.text: At the office, your manager hints that performance will decide next quarter's raises. Everyone is watching who speaks up first.

choices.label: Ask with evidence and numbers
choices.resultText: You calmly connect your work to results. The manager marks you as 'ready for more'.

choices.label: Ask indirectly with a friendly pitch
choices.resultText: You keep it light and persuasive. It is not a promise yet, but the tone shifts in your favor.

choices.label: Push too hard and threaten to leave
choices.resultText: Your message lands, but the office politics turn sour.

events.text: A project slips. Your team knows it is your area, but the client is already impatient.

choices.label: Own the mistake and propose a recovery plan
choices.resultText: You lay out a realistic timeline and delegate the last-mile work. People start trusting you again.

choices.label: Blame delays on others
choices.resultText: The room goes quiet. Your credibility drops immediately.

choices.label: Work late to fix it now
choices.resultText: You sacrifice comfort to deliver. The client gets a clean handover.

events.text: During a meeting, your team starts arguing about credit. The atmosphere is tense and everyone is ready to explode.

choices.label: De-escalate and split responsibility clearly
choices.resultText: You redirect the blame into a plan. Your calm makes you look like leadership material.

choices.label: Let it burn; stay quiet until later
choices.resultText: You avoid the conflict, but you also miss the chance to build influence.

choices.label: Publicly defend your work aggressively
choices.resultText: Your defense becomes a fight. Even if you were right, the delivery was wrong.

events.text: A senior role opens up. Your manager says the promotion will reward more than skill - it will reward reliability under pressure.

choices.label: Volunteer for the hardest part first
choices.resultText: You show commitment through action. Your performance score jumps instantly.

choices.label: Prepare carefully and present a strategy
choices.resultText: You make the role look manageable. People trust your plan.

choices.label: Decline politely and protect your routine
choices.resultText: You keep your life stable, but you lose momentum for this cycle.

events.text: A coworker recognizes you in front of the team. The mention is small, but the meaning is huge: 'They noticed your effort.'

choices.label: Thank them and share credit
choices.resultText: You become known as someone people want on their side.

choices.label: Accept it quietly and move on
choices.resultText: The moment passes, but your reputation stays steady.

choices.label: Turn it into a brag
choices.resultText: It feels satisfying for a second, but you lose goodwill quickly.
